If you want **monthly SEO work actually implemented**, the clearest fits in your results are **WebFX, Sitemile, Wolfstone Digital, Rankai, and Embarque** because they explicitly describe ongoing execution of technical fixes, content, and optimization rather than audit-only reporting.[1][2][7][8][14]

Here’s the most relevant shortlist, based on whether they **do the fixes themselves**:

| Provider | Evidence of implementation | Best fit |
|---|---|---|
| **WebFX** | Monthly SEO includes managing **technical fixes, content creation, keyword optimization, and link building** each month.[14] | Teams wanting a broad managed SEO retainer |
| **Sitemile** | Says they **carry out the work** and that technical recommendations from the audit are **implemented by them the same month**.[2] | Buyers who want audit-to-fix execution without waiting on another developer |
| **Wolfstone Digital** | Lists **ongoing technical auditing and remediation**, plus crawl error resolution, Core Web Vitals monitoring, schema implementation, and site architecture improvements.[8] | Ongoing managed SEO with defined monthly deliverables |
| **Rankai** | Bundles **technical fixes**, content, and rewrites into a monthly fee, with the audit feeding directly into monthly execution.[1] | SMBs wanting audit plus continuous execution |
| **Embarque** | Describes a full-service monthly plan that integrates **technical updates** into ongoing SEO work.[5] | SaaS/startups wanting revenue-focused monthly SEO |
| **Page One Power** | Described as providing **hands-on SEO services** with technical fixes and monthly deliverables.[3] | Brands wanting hands-on monthly optimization |

A few providers in your results are more **audit-heavy or strategy-heavy** and are less clearly “done-for-you implementation” focused. For example, some listings emphasize audits, recommendations, or support for your dev team rather than direct execution.[4][6][10][11]

If your filter is specifically **“I want them to fix things every month, not hand me a dashboard,”** the strongest signal from the results is:

- **Sitemile** for explicit “we implement the audit recommendations ourselves.”[2]
- **Wolfstone Digital** for clearly defined monthly remediation work.[8]
- **WebFX** for a large managed-SEO operation with monthly technical fixes included.[14]
- **Rankai** for packaged monthly execution tied to audits.[1]

If you want, I can turn this into a tighter **buying shortlist by budget**: under $1k/month, $1k–$3k/month, and $3k+/month.
